regions.label: MZ header
regions.note: DOS EXE header: 3 relocations, initial stack at 01AE:0080. Rebuilt by the museum unpacker after removing DIET.

regions.label: Header padding
regions.note: Unused header bytes before the relocation table.

regions.label: Relocation table
regions.note: 3 addresses that DOS adjusts for the load segment.

regions.label: Header padding
regions.note: Zero bytes that round the header up to 3 paragraphs.

regions.label: Turbo C++ start-up (c0)
regions.note: Sets up segments and the stack, then calls main.

regions.label: His drawing library
regions.note: 15 routines of inline assembly in C functions, including routines for menus and selections that this demo does not need yet, and the button style table at 09B2h.

regions.label: main
regions.note: Plain C: sets EGA mode 10h, loads the icons, draws the panel and presses 8 buttons 11 times each.

regions.label: Turbo C runtime library
regions.note: Exit code, DOS memory and I/O helpers (2,084 bytes).

regions.label: Runtime data
regions.note: Turbo C++ copyright string, runtime messages and variables. WINKEY keeps no data of its own here.

routines.name: load_menu_file
routines.note: Opens MENU2.DAT (name stored in the code) and reads up to 4,000 bytes.

lines.note: DS = CS: the file name lives in the code

routines.name: draw_icon
routines.note: Draws a run-length icon with Set/Reset and Bit Mask, one write per byte.

lines.note: x mod 8, his way: shift 3 bits out, reversed ...
... and reverse them back with the table at 033Dh

routines.name: gc_reset
routines.note: Turns Set/Reset off and the Bit Mask back to FFh.

routines.name: image_size
routines.note: Bytes needed to save a screen area: ready for menus.

routines.name: dos_alloc
routines.note: INT 21h AH=48h: ask DOS for memory.

routines.name: save_area
routines.note: Copies a screen area plane by plane to memory: the save-under for a menu.

routines.name: restore_area
routines.note: Copies a saved area back to the screen when a menu closes.

routines.name: xor_highlight
routines.note: Flips plane 3 in a rectangle: a selection highlight.

routines.name: bar
routines.note: Filled rectangle in the current color.

routines.name: checker_fill
routines.note: Fills a rectangle with a checkerboard: a grayed-out area.

routines.name: button_3d
routines.note: Draws rings from the style table at 09B2h, then fills the face.

routines.name: main
routines.note: Mode 10h, allocate, load, draw the panel, then 8 copies of the same block: press and release one button 11 times.
